lines: Mind the loom. What do you need?
Step clear of the loom. What do you need?
Mind the loom. I'm listening.
There you are. I was wondering who left those tracks by the pen.
Hello. Did you come to talk or trade?
Give me a moment to finish this row.
You have good timing. The flock just settled.
Come in out of the wind.
I can spare a few minutes before the evening count.
Watch your sleeve near that spindle.
If this is about the loose sheep, I already know.
Welcome. What brings you by?
Set your pack down if you plan to stay awhile.
I was about to make tea. Speak while the water warms.
You look like you walked a long way to get here.
The dye needs time to set, so you have my attention.
Close the gate behind you, please.
I remember you. How have you been?
Careful where you step. There is wool underfoot.
All right, I am listening.
